# Test error handling scenarios across PE commands

env PE_TEST_MODE=true

# Test file I/O errors
# Test reading from nonexistent directory
! exec pe run /nonexistent/directory/file.txt
stderr 'error'

# Test writing to read-only location (simulate)
mkdir readonly
chmod 444 readonly
! exec pe run "test" > readonly/output.txt
stderr .

# Test invalid YAML configuration
exec cat > invalid.yaml <<'EOF'
invalid: yaml: content: [
  - missing closing bracket
EOF

! exec pe eval invalid.yaml
stderr 'error'

# Test malformed JSON output
exec cat > bad-json.yaml <<'EOF'
description: "Test"
prompts: ["test"]
providers: [{"name": "mock"}]
tests: [{"assert": [{"type": "invalid_type"}]}]
EOF

! exec pe eval bad-json.yaml
stderr 'error'

# Test missing required fields in config
exec cat > missing-fields.yaml <<'EOF'
description: "Missing prompts field"
providers: [{"name": "mock"}]
EOF

! exec pe eval missing-fields.yaml
stderr 'error'

# Test network timeout simulation
env PE_TIMEOUT=1ms
! exec pe run "test with timeout"
stderr .

# Test invalid provider
! exec pe run "test" --provider nonexistent
stderr 'provider.*not.*found'

# Test invalid template syntax
exec pe run "Invalid template {{.unclosed"
stdout 'Invalid template {{.unclosed'

# Test missing template variable
exec pe run "Hello {{.missing_var}}"
stdout '{{.missing_var}}'

# Test permission denied on cache directory
mkdir -p .pe/cache
chmod 000 .pe/cache
exec pe run "test"
# Should still work, just no caching
stdout .
chmod 755 .pe/cache

# Test concurrent access to same file
exec cat > shared.yaml <<'EOF'
description: "Shared config"
prompts: ["test"]
providers: [{"name": "mock"}]
EOF

# These should not interfere with each other
exec pe eval shared.yaml &
exec pe eval shared.yaml &
wait
! stderr 'error'

# Test large input handling
exec dd if=/dev/zero bs=1024 count=1024 | pe run -
stdout .

# Test binary file handling
exec echo -ne '\x00\x01\x02\x03' > binary.dat
exec pe run binary.dat
stdout .

# Test file path with spaces
mkdir 'dir with spaces'
exec echo 'test content' > 'dir with spaces/file with spaces.txt'
exec pe run 'dir with spaces/file with spaces.txt'
stdout 'test content'

# Test symlink handling
exec ln -sf missing_target.txt broken_link.txt
exec pe run broken_link.txt
stdout 'Mock response'

# Test pipe handling with errors
! exec sh -c 'false | pe run -'
stderr .

# Test signal handling (SIGINT simulation)
exec timeout 1s pe run "long running prompt" || true
! stderr 'panic'

# Cleanup
chmod -R 755 readonly
rm -rf readonly 'dir with spaces' .pe
